mentions.name: Mike Conley
mentions.analysis: It's really hard to consider Mike Conley a must hold if he's playing 24-25 minutes a night. There's probably enough evidence in the rotations that Chris Finch is using that that's not going to change.

mentions.name: Jaylen Smith
mentions.analysis: Jaylen Smith is probable for the game and could be a streaming option given the low volume days.

mentions.name: Patrick Williams
mentions.analysis: Patrick Williams could be a stream option, especially if Zach LaVine is out, as he would likely get more minutes.

mentions.name: Ayo Dosunmu
mentions.analysis: Ayo Dosunmu could be the stream guy if Zach LaVine is out, as he would likely get more minutes.

mentions.name: John Collins
mentions.analysis: John Collins has been ridiculously good, but his minutes have been low. It's uncertain if he will continue to have high production or revert to being waiver wire fodder.

mentions.name: Cody Williams
mentions.analysis: Cody Williams is expected to start for Utah but is a big do-nothing player. He could be a stream option for occasional points and rebounds.

mentions.name: Harrison Barnes
mentions.analysis: Harrison Barnes is worth a look as a stream option with three games on low volume days.

mentions.name: Alexandre Sarr
mentions.analysis: Alexandre Sarr is underrepresented on rosters and should be added and started basically everywhere.

mentions.name: Julian Champagnie
mentions.analysis: Julian Champagnie is a stream option available in many leagues, especially with Devin Vassell out.

mentions.name: Nikola Jovic
mentions.analysis: Nikola Jovic's value could rise if Lauri Markkanen is out, making him a potential stream option.

mentions.name: AJ Green
mentions.analysis: AJ Green can shoot and might get more minutes over Gary Trent Jr., but it's uncertain if this will continue.

mentions.name: Scoot Henderson
mentions.analysis: Scoot Henderson is a stream option, especially with Shaden Sharpe questionable and other players out.

mentions.name: Keldon Johnson
mentions.analysis: Keldon Johnson is someone to watch with the absence of Jeremy Sochan. He might start or play significant minutes off the bench.
